headline: Frontlines flare across contested sectors as casualties mount
war_summary: On day 676 of War 140 the map remains sharply divided: Colonials hold the majority of western and central hexes, while Wardens control a northern arc and several interior sectors. The bloodiest fighting continues in Callahans Passage, where both sides have suffered over 300,000 combined casualties, and in the Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse, each recording tens of thousands of losses in the past 24 hours. Enlistment figures are climbing in most active zones, notably in Weathered Expanse (21 per hour), Kuura Strand (60 per hour) and Marban Hollow (26 per hour), indicating fresh troop influx. Strategic‑base ownership is shifting most rapidly in six regions: Weathered Expanse (55 base events, five bases hotly contested), Marban Hollow (33 events, Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall leading), Kuura Strand (31 events, Menneen and Faden Point most active), Olavis Wake (22 events, Koskinla and Ilmari Bridge), Pari Peak (22 events, Pariah and Kohina Base), and Nevish Line (16 events, Tomb Father and Blackcoat Way). Elsewhere the front is largely static, with no base captures reported in the last day.
